ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(OR(AND(NOT(AND(DAY(TODAY())>=1, DAY(TODAY())<=17, MONTH(TODAY())==1)), (YEAR( Report_Date__c ) < YEAR(TODAY())) ), AND(AND(DAY(TODAY())>=1, DAY(TODAY())<=17, MONTH(TODAY())==1), (YEAR( Report_Date__c ) < YEAR(TODAY())-1) )), ISNEW() )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Report Date shouldn't be previous year, if Today is not between the first 10 days of this year.
